sources.note: An edited documentary record of events from March 1927 to November 1956. Added in step 6 because the Timeline Wall needs dated events, with pages to cite, that volumes 1 and 7 do not record. Its frontispiece is kept as a plate: its caption gives the dates of birth and death, which no numbered page does.

sources.title: The Protection of Civil Rights Act, 1955 (22 of 1955)
sources.creator: Parliament of India
sources.publisher: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
sources.rights: An Act of Parliament. Consolidated text as published by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
sources.note: Enacted as the Untouchability (Offences) Act, 1955, in force from 1 June 1955, and renamed by Act 106 of 1976, which also inserted the definition of civil rights that cites Article 17. This is the Ministry's consolidated text, with the 1976 amendments marked in brackets and its own typographical errors; India Code, the authoritative copy, did not answer this build machine. Replace the source with India Code's when it can be fetched.
